scope: Official forum numerical regression, explicit level mappings, immutable local calculation records, mounted DOM interactions and responsive CSS contracts. Not browser visual/layout/gameplay verification.

checks.name: Known species and forum cultivation baseline is unchanged
Mapping has forty explicit levels and a primary official forum provenance
All mapped levels 1–4 use the sourced +1 five-stat bonus
All mapped levels 5–9 use the sourced +7 five-stat bonus
All mapped levels 10–14 use the sourced +13 five-stat bonus
All mapped levels 15–20 use the sourced +20 five-stat bonus
All mapped levels 21–26 use the sourced +28 five-stat bonus
All mapped levels 27–32 use the sourced +34 five-stat bonus
All mapped levels 33–39 use the sourced +40 five-stat bonus
All mapped levels 40–40 use the sourced +50 five-stat bonus
Zero explicitly disables the guardian without inventing level zero game data
Missing level data stops the calculation rather than interpolating or using zero
Invalid guardian level "" is rejected
Invalid guardian level "1.5" is rejected
Invalid guardian level "-1" is rejected
Invalid guardian level "41" is rejected
Invalid guardian level "Infinity" is rejected
Legacy bonus values migrate to a labelled range, not a fabricated exact level
Old max-stage links still yield the exact same six numbers
Named equipment is added after nature and guardian stays outside panel
Magic weapon, armor and accessory affect only their respective dimensions
Named level 100 gear rejects a lower-level pet
Manual three-slot values apply separately to the selected dimensions
Manual gear is explicitly marked and may not alter speed
Accessory secondary affixes remain one-of metadata, excluded from six stats
Effort and intimacy validation remain intact
Nature-before-equipment rounding regression remains exact
All 18 official forum damage fixtures remain unchanged (21 rolls each)
Snapshot saves identity, nature, complete inputs, result and version
Saved calculations are immutable after the live form changes
Same-pet comparison includes six deltas and nature/guardian changes
Comparison direction is B minus A and can be reversed
Cross-pet comparisons explicitly include species differences
Duplicate snapshot IDs are rejected without overwriting records
Failed writes report failure and preserve previous local records
Malformed storage is not silently erased by a new save
Only the selected snapshot is deleted
Invalid live inputs cannot become a saved record
Compact calculator directly exposes nature, guardian level input and six results
All calculator dropdowns use the shared custom component
Live guardian level produces five +50 results and unchanged speed
Saving a live compact calculation opens its named record with an A marker
Two saves immediately create a six-row comparison with visible nature differences
Loading a saved record restores live parameters and preserves both snapshots
Changing species resets level, nature, guardian and live identity together
Different species starts with a scoped empty history while retaining previous records
All-records view exposes prior pets without restoring them into the wrong pet
Manual gear has an inline sourced-scope explanation and affects only its chosen stat
Invalid input displays the error and disables snapshot save
Actual save-button failure stays on the calculation and shows no false saved entry
Resize events and repeated route identity changes do not throw or erase live inputs
Full capability tool reads the compact form through the same calculation core
Full tool also uses guardian levels and the shared snapshots section
Changing the full-tool species clears the old comparison selection and rescopes history
Old full-tool links visibly disclose stage migration and retain their numeric result
Partial shared links retain the explicit no-guardian default instead of manufacturing a migration error
Capability CSS sets bounded inputs, min-zero grids, breakpoints and internal comparison scrolling
No React runtime warnings or uncaught exceptions occurred in mounted calculator flows
